title: Qt: Lua Debugger: Add-watch from selection, skip duplicates
description:
- Toolbar Add Watch pre-fills from the current editor selection when
  any text is selected; otherwise a new row opens for edit as before.
- When inserting a non-empty spec, a matching watch row is selected
  instead of creating a second entry.
- Code/variables context menus: Add Watch actions are not gated on a
  paused run loop, so the same path/selection can be used while not
  debugging.

Ping #21193

AI-Assisted: yes
